summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the escape format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title(title) classmethod with a docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, buffering the control only when is_terminal is true and returning True/False; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and Black formatting are unverified. Nothing was committed.
